prompts.prompt: how to find MCP servers for Claude
prompts.surface: WebSearch (AI-answer style search) plus source links; opened mcpstepbystep.com guide
prompts.synthesis: Browse Anthropic’s Connectors Directory in Claude: open Customize > Connectors, then select “+” to search verified and community MCP connectors. For Claude Code, use `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>` to add a remote server. If you find a server elsewhere, add it as a custom connector by entering its remote MCP URL in Customize > Connectors > Add > Custom.
